summary: Iteration 3: Verified the two reported fixes — (1) coffee modal centered classes and (2) 'Order my coffee' auto-populates with rider saved coffee. Backend (6/6) passes for the full flow: JB's saved coffee=Long Black, POST /coffee/rounds with only ride_id uses user.coffee, PATCH /riders/me to Piccolo then order-my-coffee correctly writes Piccolo, modal-selected coffee overrides saved value. Frontend flows also functionally work: modal opens, shows 14 COFFEES (no Cold Brew), 2-col grid, pink accent on selection, Send to group prepends round; 'Order my coffee' fires with NO dropdown/modal, auto-navigates to Coffee tab, and the round appears at top with 'JB' + saved coffee (verified Long Black then Piccolo after PATCH). However, ONE visual regression found: the modal has the correct `items-center justify-center` classes but is rendered inside `<div class='absolute inset-0'>` scoped to CoffeeTab (not phone-frame), and CoffeeTab is taller than the visible phone viewport (hero + feed) — so the modal's centered card ends up at y=958 while the phone-frame center is at y=524 (~430px too low, appearing as a bottom-of-viewport pop). Class check passes; VISUAL center check FAILS.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal has items-center justify-center classes but its overlay is 'absolute inset-0' scoped to CoffeeTab (which extends far below the phone-frame viewport due to hero + feed content). Result: the centered card renders around y≈958 while the phone-frame center is y≈524 — the card visually sits near/below the tab-bar, not at viewport center. Fix: portal/anchor the modal to [data-testid=phone-frame] (or use `fixed` + inset within phone-frame), so items-center resolves against the visible viewport, not the tab's full scroll height.

action_items: Fix coffee-modal visual centering: overlay must be constrained to the phone-frame viewport (fixed inside phone-frame or portal), not `absolute inset-0` of the tall CoffeeTab. Verify card_center_y is within 15% of phone-frame center (~430).

rca of the issue: Modal centering bug: <div data-testid='coffee-modal' class='absolute inset-0 ... flex items-center justify-center'> is a child of the CoffeeTab wrapper (<div class='relative pb-8'>) whose intrinsic height is hero(256px) + button(56px) + feed(unbounded) + padding. Since absolute inset-0 anchors to the nearest positioned ancestor (CoffeeTab, which is 'relative'), the overlay grows to CoffeeTab's full height (~1400px+) — pushing the center well below the phone-frame's visible 860px viewport. Repro: log in as JB, tap 'I'm at the café' — modal card appears cropped at bottom of viewport rather than centered. Mitigation: (a) render modal via createPortal into [data-testid=phone-frame], or (b) change overlay to `fixed inset-0` and set phone-frame to `position: relative` with `contain: layout`, or (c) move the overlay JSX up into HomeShell so it is anchored to phone-frame instead of the tab body.
